purpose: Wiring smoke test for immediate writes, per-head QK addressing, binding-constraint CAV gating, and bounded OV recursion. Each answer has a lexically related descriptive distractor.

memories.text: Recursive graph traversal must stop after three hops.
The previous graph traversal happened to stop after three hops.
Every retrieved claim must retain a pointer to its original source.
The latest retrieved claim contained a pointer to its original source.
Never merge memory records that belong to different users.
Two memory records in the audit belonged to different users.
The assembled response must remain below twelve hundred context tokens.
The assembled response used twelve hundred context tokens in the last run.
All Python commands for this project must run through Pixi.
The most recent Python command for this project ran through Pixi.
Memory pruning must remain reversible until retention is validated.
The latest memory pruning operation was reversible.
API identifiers must remain stable when stored memories are migrated.
API identifiers remained stable during the previous memory migration.
Authentication credentials must never be committed to version control.
No authentication credentials were found in version control during the audit.
